notice: All people, messages, account attributes, source documents, and histories are fictional. Not actual Bankrate policies. Expected outcomes are proposed review labels, not expert-adjudicated ground truth.

product_scope_basis.depth: Brief official-source scope check only; not a product audit.

references.title: Bankrate — About
references.supports: Bankrate covers mortgages, banking, credit cards, and loans; it is not a bank or lender.

references.title: Bankrate — Mortgage rates
references.supports: Mortgage rate and lender comparisons; a lender’s actual quote depends on borrower and lender factors.

product_scope_basis.assumptions: All incidents and help-center policies are synthetic. Member settings, authentication flows, consent incidents, accessibility issues, and data exposure are hypothetical. No actual misconduct is alleged.

usage: Sanitized historical fixture corpus only. Do not include current-case expected labels in retrieval. All prior events and review states are fictional.

retrieval_design.ranking: Prefer shared issue themes and category, then compare severity. Show differences; a severity match alone is insufficient. No calibrated similarity score is claimed.
retrieval_design.results: Up to three relevant references with title, category, severity, match explanation, differences, and handling outcome. Return fewer or none when evidence is weak.
retrieval_design.action_boundary: Validate historical suggestions against current policy; agents confirm actions through existing workflow.
retrieval_design.fallback: History unavailable or no match: continue current-case summary and policy-based assistance with an explicit limitation.

historical_cases.title: Routine request with unequal-treatment allegation
historical_cases.sanitized_description: A member asked for account help and reported unequal treatment during a third-party lender application.
historical_cases.permission_note: Contains only a fictional, sanitized workflow reference. Original restricted case content is not included.
steps_taken: Separate the routine request from the reported risk in the internal summary.
Record what was reported and which evidence is missing.
Review the restricted handoff and confirm Compliance/Legal ownership.
historical_cases.handling_outcome: A restricted specialist handoff was acknowledged. No AI member answer was produced; legal merits were not assessed.
historical_cases.limitations: Historical handling is context, not proof that the current allegation is true, a legal finding, or authorization to repeat an action.
